keyword: how to wish someone a happy eid
claims: The most common and traditional way to wish someone a happy Eid is by saying "Eid Mubarak" or "Happy Eid".
"Eid Mubarak lakum wa-li-'a'ilatakum" means "Blessed Eid to you and your family".
"Kul 'am wa-antum bi-khayr" means "May you celebrate this every year" or "May every year find you in good health".
Eid greetings are typically exchanged during the days of Eid al-Fitr or Eid al-Adha.
